plugin.description: Sets a Luxafor Flag USB status light to a color. Every Set Color key shows whether its own color is the one the Flag currently shows, so a row of them behaves like radio buttons.
plugin.requirements: A Luxafor Flag plugged in over USB, and the udev rule from the plugin's udev/ folder installed so StreamController can open it without root.

SetColor.description: Sets the Flag to the configured color when pressed. The key shows a bright dot when that color is active and a dim outline otherwise.

color.description: The color to set. "off" turns the Flag off.
